name: Helpmeet
overview: The Bible presents the helpmeet as a divinely appointed partner created to complement and support the man, emphasizing that it is not good for man to be alone and that a suitable helper is necessary (Genesis 2:18). This partnership is foundational to the marriage relationship, where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). The helpmeet is also implied in the call to exercise dominion together over creation (Genesis 1:28), and her value is celebrated in Proverbs as far above rubies (Proverbs 31:10), highlighting her virtuous and indispensable role in the God-ordained order.
